ai_model.description: AI model: 'meshy-7' (default, currently resolves to Meshy 7). IMPORTANT: Before calling this tool, ask the user which model to use and explain the differences: meshy-7/latest = best quality (20 credits), meshy-7 = previous gen (5 credits)

file_path.description: ABSOLUTE path to LOCAL image (.jpg/.png). PREFERRED for local files. Server auto-encodes. Example: /Users/me/photo.jpg. NEVER manually base64-encode.

image_url.description: PUBLIC image URL (https://...). Use ONLY for remote images. For local files use file_path instead. NEVER manually base64-encode.

input_task_id.description: Chain from a SUCCEEDED text-to-image or image-to-image task: use its generated image as the input instead of image_url/file_path. Provide only one image source.

multi_view_thumbnails.description: Also return 4 cardinal-view thumbnails (front/back/left/right). Default false.

pose_mode.description: Pose mode for character models: 'a-pose' or 't-pose'. IMPORTANT: When the user intends to rig or animate the model, default to 't-pose' for best rigging results
